title: POST accounts/:id/orders/strategy
summary: Allows to (re)place or estimate impact of a multi-leg strategy order against a certain account.

cells:
Account number against which order is being submitted.

Can occur in the 'Location' header only.

Internal symbol identifier.

Always an underlying symbol Id.

Order type (e.g., "Market").

See [Order Type](/api/documentation/rest-operations/enumerations/enumerations#order-type) section for all allowed values.

Order duration (e.g., "DAY").

See [Order Duration](/api/documentation/rest-operations/enumerations/enumerations#order-time-in-force) section for all allowed values.

Strategy type (e.g. "CoveredCall")

See [Strategy Types](/api/documentation/rest-operations/enumerations/enumerations#strategy-types) section for all allowed values.

Leg action (e.g. "Buy")
See [Order Action](/api/documentation/rest-operations/enumerations/enumerations#order-action) section for all allowed values.

blocks.text: If the Strategy Type is set as not Custom, then it will be verified to the mentioned strategy.

NOTE: Leg quantities will be factorized. For example, if you place quantities of 10 and 1000, then they will be sent as an order quantity of 10 and leg ratio quantities of 1 and 100. Price also uses a factorized strategy. Refer to the strategy quote call to be sure which price to use.
Data is the same but URLs for insertion and impact are slightly different.
